Work Process

Step 1

Requirement Gathering

Collect business goals, user needs, technical constraints, and success criteria with all stakeholders.

Step 2

Analysis & Estimation

Break requirements into deliverables, define scope, estimate effort, and prioritize milestones.

Step 3

Architecture & Design

Design scalable frontend/backend architecture, data flow, API contracts, and UI interaction patterns.

Step 4

Development

Implement features in iterative sprints with code reviews, clean commits, and regular client demos.

Step 5

Testing & QA

Run functional, integration, responsiveness, and performance checks; fix defects before release.

Step 6

Deployment

Deploy through CI/CD with environment checks, release notes, and rollback readiness.

Step 7

Monitoring & Maintenance

Monitor production behavior, address issues quickly, apply updates, and plan continuous improvements.
